bio: As a sniper who can shoot at light speed, it's no surprise Orchira ended up in the employ of High Prince Malkanis. She acts as part of his security detail – she can spot if even a hair has been disturbed on the prince's head, from a rooftop half a mile away. And should anyone dare to harm him, they'll be peppered with Orchira's hardlight arrows before they can even blink.
